issues.message: Non-functional requirements (NFRs) are not explicitly defined. Missing performance metrics, security requirements beyond authentication, scalability targets, availability SLAs, and data retention policies.
Administrator role is mentioned in user_roles but has no associated features, user stories, or acceptance criteria. Administrator functionality is undefined.

Security requirements are incomplete. Only JWT Authentication is mentioned but missing: password policies, data encryption at rest/transit, HIPAA compliance considerations for medical data, session management, and audit logging requirements.
No administrator interface or screens defined despite Administrator being a defined user role. Admin functionality for managing users, doctors, and system configuration is missing.
Performance requirements not specified. Missing: expected response times, concurrent user capacity, appointment search performance targets, and notification delivery SLAs.
Error handling and validation feedback patterns not explicitly defined in UI components. Error states for failed bookings, network errors, and validation messages need specification.
Data retention and privacy policies not defined. Medical data handling, patient data deletion requests, and appointment history retention periods need clarification.
No explicit soft delete mechanism defined. Cancelled appointments retain status but deleted user/doctor accounts may cause referential integrity issues.

required_fixes: Define comprehensive non-functional requirements including performance metrics (response time < 2s, support for X concurrent users), security standards (HIPAA compliance, encryption), availability targets (99.9% uptime), and scalability requirements
Complete Administrator role definition with features, user stories, and acceptance criteria for user management, doctor approval, system configuration, and reporting
Specify detailed security requirements: password complexity rules, MFA options, data encryption standards, session timeout policies, audit logging, and HIPAA compliance measures for medical data
Add administrator screens to design including admin dashboard, user management, doctor approval workflow, and system settings interfaces
Define error handling patterns and validation feedback in design with specific error messages, retry mechanisms, and user guidance for common failure scenarios
recommendations: Add explicit performance benchmarks to requirements such as: appointment search results in under 1 second, support for 10,000 concurrent users, notification delivery within 30 seconds, and database query optimization targets
Implement comprehensive audit logging in database schema to track all CRUD operations on sensitive medical data, appointment changes, and user actions for compliance and security monitoring
Consider adding a soft delete mechanism with 'deleted_at' timestamp columns to maintain referential integrity and support data recovery scenarios while complying with data retention policies
Enhance notification system with retry logic, delivery status tracking, and fallback channels (if SMS fails, send email) to ensure critical appointment reminders reach patients

Add data validation rules to database schema using CHECK constraints for fields like appointment status, user roles, day_of_week ranges, and time formats to ensure data integrity at the database level
Include accessibility testing requirements in the quality checklist such as screen reader compatibility testing, keyboard navigation verification, and color contrast validation tools
Define API rate limiting and throttling requirements to prevent abuse and ensure fair resource allocation across users, especially for search and booking endpoints
